Ruling bar (from `watch/inbox/ELDER_DASH25_RULING_20260922.md`): harvest the mechanism, tombstone the shell; triangulation not import; graft/tombstone/idle **with a bar**; nothing deleted without operator yes. Doctrine organ: THPS *speed pays score continuously · LINE ×N* (`watch/inbox/GAMES_SITE_PLAYTEST_20260921.md` ROUND 2 item 3; `lineMult` named load-bearing in `watch/inbox/LANE_COLLAB_SYNTHESIS_20260921.md`).

Hashes re-verified at read time (sha256sum, match `watch/inbox/RIDE_FAMILY_VERDICTS_20260922.md`): sunset `864e5c88…dcd9b`, v2 `f90dfeb0…57f95`, arrakis stub `aa6d3fba…d0adc`, games/arrakis `13831397…33567`.

## 1. `dashboard/static/wipeout_sunset.html` (360 lines) — **GRAFT** (mechanism; shell tombstone-eligible after port)

**Mechanism embodied:** honest collision against an audio-driven world. A JS mirror of the shader terrain (`terrainH`/`trinoiseH`, lines 236–265) samples ahead each tick and crashes on `peak > 1.55` (line 321) — "collisions are math, not vibes" (line 56). Live FFT feeds the shader through a 128×1 LUMINANCE `iChannel0` texture (lines 334–337), and the same audio sample subtracts into terrain height (line 110), so music literally builds the hazard. Score = survival: hull 3 as lives, end grade is % of song survived, S/A/B/C (lines 350–355).

**Fit against doctrine:** This is exactly the KEEP item in `watch/inbox/static_rebuild/LANE_C_wipeout.md` — "sunset's iChannel0 FFT-texture feed and its JS-terrain-mirror collision pattern — the bridge that gives any shader world honest math collisions." It fails speed=score itself (speed constant `10*speedMult`, line 332; score is endurance, not speed), but the ruling harvests the *mechanism it embodies*, not conformance: this bridge is the only on-disk piece that can arbitrate a line-multiplier ride fairly against a music-driven world. The shell (WebGL1/ES1 path, triplicated menu/CSS, `performance.now()` clock) sits on the same file's RETIRE list.

**Bar:** port only the collision+FFT bridge; menu/CSS/clock/WebGL1 shell moves to the tombstone list after the graft lands.

## 2. `dashboard/static/wipeout_v2.html` (293 lines) — **IDLE**

**Mechanism embodied:** speed as physics, not as score. The BPM autocorrelator (`analyze()`, lines 236–244) becomes the world clock; `uEnergy` multiplies speed (line 171: `speed = bpm*(1.+uEnergy*.8)`); song-hash seeds the world (line 282 — seed is *filename length*, a known defect). No ship, no collision, no score — SPD/DIST HUD (lines 284–285) is cosmetic readout of a passive camera flight.

**Fit against doctrine:** fails speed=score outright — speed pays nothing; there is no score to pay into. Its `analyze()` is already earmarked for dedupe into one shared module (`LANE_C_wipeout.md` KEEP: "the `analyze()` autocorrelator — keep ONCE"; currently pasted verbatim in v2 and `wipeout_lightmaze.html`), and its filename-length seed is on the RETIRE list. Nothing left to graft from the page body that the shared-module cut won't take anyway; not hot enough to tombstone while that target is pending.

**Bar:** no action this wave. Re-evaluate only when the shared wipeout module (`wipeout_state.js` + one shell) is cut.

## 3. `dashboard/static/arrakis.html` (6 lines) — **TOMBSTONE** (already executed; leave it)

**Mechanism embodied:** none. It is a meta-refresh stub to `/static/games/arrakis.html`, dated "dedupe 2026-09-22 (surfaces-functional)" (line 5). No game code, no score, no ride.

**Fit against doctrine:** already the Elder's own end state — one canonical copy, redirect stub as rest-mark, no core-mirror throne. Correct; nothing further to do. **Canonical ride note:** I read `dashboard/static/games/arrakis.html` (241 lines) for fit — it holds only pre-THPS mechanics: score = `P.spice` count (line 124), and speed is a *liability* (`thump` rises when `sp>1.6`, line 120; worm activates at `thump>35`, hunts you, eats 3 spice on contact, lines 159–163). `grep lineMult` acros

## The verkle/chain visual family — six files, read in full

All paths under `dashboard/static/` unless noted. Prior-audit cross-references from `research/surface_audit/df3.json`, `df5.json`.

### `verkle_construction.html` — THE BIRTH CANVAS
**Does:** Fetches `index_data/verkle_birth.json` and renders the chain as *time*: dream wing (2023→the 2026-08-10 seam, 19 castle markers with latency rays to their build dates) vs build wing (knot swarm in family colors, era bands, THE SILENCE hatched as a wound, cumulative line, 11 tri-state fact cards incl. LAW-10 UNPROVEN).
**Record-steering:** *Expectation latency* — each castle→built ray prints "how long an idea took to become foundation" (rays labeled in days/years), plus the SEAM doctrine as a dated line. The record steers planning by making imagination-to-build lag visible; the silence band steers by keeping the wound in frame.
**Fit:** Only surface in the family with a time axis (worker-C survey, `memory/trajectory/steps.jsonl:3024`); data 09-09, page receipt-verified. Fits the DNA (filed workdays).
**Verdict: GRAFT.**

### `verkle_knot_wave.html`
**Does:** 2D standing-wave body of the chain from shared `game_verkle_knots.js`: golden-angle layout, oscillators sized by tension, residual>0.3 → glow halo, traveling pulse = an idea propagating via steal, white tip = head; hover reads the knot's real receipt (hash, ts, session, tension, dirichlet, Q, residual).
**Record-steering:** *Residual/salience field* — past work that left residue literally glows harder; the record steers attention by weight, and hover makes any point falsifiable on demand.
**Fit:** Canonical twin — zero-network, cited as evidence in `audit_prep/identity_schema.md:60` and measured in `experiments/verkle_knot_standing_wave.yaml`; df5 verdict KEEP. But no age stamp, and its dataset is the stalest (below).
**Verdict: GRAFT** (with the regen obligation).

### `verkle_pyramid.html`
**Does:** WebGL SDF neon pyramid (operator-supplied shader): big pyramid = structure, cells = knots, descending laser = the audit walk, sparks = events. Claims "byte-driven from verkle_chain.jsonl via state/verkle_pyramid_seed.json".
**Record-steering:** *Ambient audit* — the laser is "the audit is always walking" as decoration. Byte-coupling is thin: `uKnots` is set but never used in the shader; only `uTip` seeds the laser path; caption cites `state/` for a file actually fetched at page root; seed (tip 09-10, 7,526 knots) has no committed regenerator (grep for `verkle_pyramid_seed` in `*.py` → only `mag/witness_snapshot.py` exists).
**Fit:** Totem, not instrument. Never audited in the df series. Honest as a hologram, dishonest as "byte-driven."
**Verdict: IDLE** (park it; fix or drop the dead uniform + wrong path claim before it ever gets promoted).

### `viz_3d_verkle.html`
**Does:** Same `game_verkle_knots.js` as a 3D helix via three.js from `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, orbit camera, identical hover readout, plus its one unique byte: polls `/api/v1/local-pulse` and drives wave frequency/amplitude from live system/LLM CPU.
**Record-steering:** *Closed-loop live coupling* — the record's motion responds to the present machine, not just history. Genuinely the only live-feedback member of the family.
**Fit:** Fails the loopback/off-cage law (df5 headline #4); duplicates knot_wave's dataset and hover exactly; df5 verdict **MERGE** with explicit instruction "port the 4-line local-pulse strip into verkle_knot_wave.html, then retire this tab" — **still unexecuted**: knot_wave has no local-pulse code.
**Verdict: TOMBSTONE** — but port the pulse strip first (it's the donor, not the keeper).

### 1. `dashboard/static/maze_arena.html` — **TOMBSTONE (already executed; leave it)**
6-line meta-refresh to `/static/games/maze_arena.html`, dated "dedupe 2026-09-22" — mechanism-free, already the Elder's own pattern (same as the arrakis stub in `RIDE_FAMILY_VERDICTS_20260922.md`).

**But the canonical `dashboard/static/games/maze_arena.html` is this lane's primary GRAFT source.** What it does: SDF walls; BFS lightmap + WebGL 1D ray-field with a 110° gaze sector composited ("two engines, one invariant: visibility"); GPS gradient-walkers vs dumb bouncers; 4 rounds incl. **dirty-radius refill** on moving walls (tesuji metric = cells recomputed) and dwell-in-gaze scoring; η/handed-curl odd field; MODEL SEAT paste-race (`RECOGNITION_PROTOCOL` door); lantern player + 6 LAW_SHARDS. **Mechanism: agents steered by a field they cannot see whole — light-over-structure GPS with incremental recompute.** Direct hit on the Elder's prediction that walk/light/maze families triangulate into **light-maze-3D** (`LIGHT_MAZE_3D_WALK_20260922.md:41-50`: aim=cone, radius=budget, occlusion=walls, first-hit=nearest organ), plus the dirty-radius refill is the eigen-map overlay's incremental-update story already proven at 60fps.

### 2. `dashboard/static/eraser_maze.html` — **GRAFT**
Does: two-layer quantum field — coherent path-sum amplitudes over route families; sight-radius **observation collapses** cells to incoherent (which-path kills fringes); `E` fires an eraser = **unitary basis rotation** (fringes return shifted, never deleted); append-only observation ledger; built-in double-slit falsifier (V_coh≈1 / V_tag≈0 / V_erase>0.5, boot-verified at line 505). **Mechanism: observation with memory — `obsStamp`/`eraseStamp` per cell, and "the chain does not invalidate, it appends."** This is exactly what light-maze-3D lacks after the wide walk found "the light's economy is **blind to gates**" (`LIGHT_MAZE_3D_WALK_20260922.md:26`): a stamp pair distinguishes *dark-because-gated* from *dark-because-never-asked*. Also the Lens Stack refusal-log primitive in miniature — a refusal class that never fired before is a basis change, an append, not an error. Bar: port the `displayInto(disp, phi, obsStamp, eraseStamp)` stamp/ledger pattern, not the game shell.

### 3. `dashboard/static/spectral_maze.html` — **GRAFT**
Does: 3 real-wavelength bands, independent Godunov eikonal least-time floods (cost = n per zone — **Snell emerges from the solver, never coded**); mirror walls (grid i≈r); waveguide walls that **leak at kinks past the band's critical angle** (TIR demux: one 63.4° kink holds blue, bleeds red); band sensors; 6 falsifiers incl. mono regression ≤1e-9 and wavefront-normal Snell scan. **Mechanism: laws-as-costs + routing-by-physics.** Two fits: (a) the eikonal flood is a strictly richer field solver than maze_arena's BFS — dispersion/occlusion variants become line items in the cost table, not new code paths (the file's own deep find, line 28: "refraction was already in the solver, asleep in a constant"); (b) the TIR demux kink is the **fleet mix law / router** rendered as geometry — capability bands split by a single gate, measurable, falsified on-page. ### 1. `dashboard/static/viz_gallery.html` — **idle**
**Mechanism:** a hand-maintained `TABS` registry (`:34-47`) + one iframe stage; `activate()` swaps `src` and writes each tab's honest caption into the header (`:59`). The mechanism is the *caption law* — every attempt filed with its own verdict ("attempt 1 — beautiful, wrong, kept as the record", line 38).
**Fit:** the record discipline is already Elder doctrine; as a steering surface it steers nothing (no data, no measure). Defect proving it's hand-typed: duplicate `id:'horse'` entries (`:40` and `:41`) — `find()` at `:52` can never reach the second.
**Bar:** launcher shell superseded by the wave's own receipts; leave, or fix the dup id if the lab stays.

### 2. `dashboard/static/museum/viz_horse_lane2_carcass.html` — **tombstone (already executed)**
**Mechanism:** closed-form gait — body bounce/pitch at `sin(t*2)` (`:38`), four legs with phase offsets `[0,0.15,0.5,0.62]` (`:47`), each a 3-point hip/knee/hoof polyline from `lift=max(0,sin(a+0.4))`, transformed through rotate+translate frame `P(x,y)` (`:41-43`); mane/tail as lagged sine point clouds.
**Fit:** zero against eigen-map/lens — no data input, no measure, no gate; pure decoration. Its caption (`:16-17`) already admits the wrong turn.
**Bar:** correctly placed in `museum/` by the gallery (`:39`); re-listing costs nothing, re-rendering gains nothing. It is the carcass its filename claims.

### 3. `dashboard/static/viz_horse_run.html` — **tombstone**
**Mechanism:** one shared **spine as generator** — `stridePhase`/`bodyBob`/`spineFlex` harmonics (`:26-35`), a 90-point parametric spine with arch/neck/tail terms (`:95-109`), then everything else *sampled off it*: 10,000-point barrel cloud at golden angle (`:119-153`), 2-segment legs with lead/trail offsets `[0,0.55,0.15,0.70]` (`:165-170`), mane and tail drawn with phase lag 0.6/0.9 (`:230,241`).
**Fit:** "subordinate organs sample a shared spine with per-part lag" is JEV-shaped, but every term is a hardcoded sine — zero inputs, zero measurement, so it fails the Lens Stack bar outright (nothing to meter, nothing to refuse). The rendering tricks (golden-angle cloud) aren't steering.
**Bar:** shell dies with honors; the spine-as-generator idea is too thin to graft — the lab's showpiece, not an instrument.
